title: picardAdjunctionSectionEvaluation
statement: Let p:Z \to Y be a scheme morphism, F:Y.Modules \to Z.Modules a functor, and adj:F \dashv p_* an adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let e:F(O_Y) \cong O_Z be an isomorphism whose adjoint transpose is the canonical structure map O_Y \to p_*O_Z. For any O_Z-module N and module morphism n:O_Z \to N, evaluate adj(e.hom followed by n) at 1 on the top open of Y and restrict from p inverse-top to top of Z. The result equals n(1) on top of Z.

proof.text: Use right naturality of the adjunction Hom equivalence, then its specified value on e. The structure-sheaf map preserves one. Naturality of n for top into inverse-top and map_one identify the value after restriction with n(1) at top.

theorem picardAdjunctionSectionEvaluation
    {Y Z : Scheme.{v}} (p : Z ⟶ Y) (F : Y.Modules ⥤ Z.Modules)
    (adj : F ⊣ Modules.pushforward p)
    (e : F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    (he : adj.homEquiv _ _ e.hom =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit p.toRingCatSheafHom)
    (N : Z.Modules) (n : SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf ⟶ N) :
    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE p.preimage_top.ge).op
      ((adj.homEquiv _ _ (e.hom ≫ n)).val.app (Opposite.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤))) =
        n.val.app (Opposite.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤))
